faq.q: What is the difference between a broker and an insurer?
faq.a: An insurer sells its own policies. As a broker, CBZ Risk Advisory works for you, comparing and negotiating cover across licensed underwriters and standing with you at claim time.

faq.q: What does an insurance audit cover?
faq.a: Every policy your organisation holds, checked for gaps, overlaps and cost, with recommendations you can act on.
Yes. Botswana Reinsurance Brokers, wholly owned, extends the broking reach regionally.

productsNote: Broking and advisory services are governed by IPEC regulations. Terms, premium rates and coverage extensions are negotiated across licensed underwriters based on risk profiling.
